description: 미스티 1214의 기존 저장 초상화 3종을 로드 시 기본 전신에 맞게 복구

edits.new:
! JO9 MOD START MISTY_PORTRAIT_LOAD_20261118
   ! Repair only the saved faces left on the old default by the Misty body update.
   if j9lc_type=1214:
    $j9lc_old=lcase(replace($j9lcactor['fullimage'],'\','/'))
    if ($j9lc_old='girls/full/1214_blue_long_young' or $j9lc_old='girls/full/1214_blue_long_young.png') or ($j9lc_old='girls/full/cloth/1214_blue_long_young' or $j9lc_old='girls/full/cloth/1214_blue_long_young.png'):
     $j9lc_old=lcase(replace($j9lcactor['ava'],'\','/'))
     if ($j9lc_old='content/pic/girls/face/1214_pink_long_young_sepia' or $j9lc_old='content/pic/girls/face/1214_pink_long_young_sepia.png'): $j9lcactor['ava']='content/pic/girls/face/1214_blue_long_young_sepia' & j9lc_changes+=1
     $j9lc_old=lcase(replace($j9lcactor['ava_gray'],'\','/'))
     if ($j9lc_old='content/pic/girls/face/1214_pink_long_young_gray' or $j9lc_old='content/pic/girls/face/1214_pink_long_young_gray.png'): $j9lcactor['ava_gray']='content/pic/girls/face/1214_blue_long_young_gray' & j9lc_changes+=1
     $j9lc_old=lcase(replace($j9lcactor['ava_clear'],'\','/'))
     if ($j9lc_old='content/pic/girls/face/1214_pink_long_young' or $j9lc_old='content/pic/girls/face/1214_pink_long_young.png'): $j9lcactor['ava_clear']='content/pic/girls/face/1214_blue_long_young' & j9lc_changes+=1
    end
   end
   ! JO9 MOD END MISTY_PORTRAIT_LOAD_20261118
   $j9lc_old=$j9lcactor['fullimage']
